verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a docs page on testing verification errors, which says you can force verification checks to fail to test your error-handling flow. That implies some test capability, but nothing explicitly describes a sandbox or test environment kept separate from production data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test environment isolated from live data, test credentials or endpoints, simulated card authorisations and transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
